slides.headline: What's the real difference?
slides.body: Trade finance is built specifically around the international or domestic trade cycle, funding supplier payments while customers meet their normal terms. Working capital finance is broader, covering general operational costs like payroll, rent and stock, without being tied to a specific trade transaction.

caption:
If your funding need is about paying an overseas supplier before a shipment arrives, that's a different problem to funding payroll during a quiet month.

Trade finance is purpose-built around the trade cycle, supplier payment through to customer payment. Working capital finance is broader, covering the general operating costs of the business without being tied to any single transaction.
